t: You're looking at the obelisk in Bunhill Fields burial ground, a monument to Daniel Defoe. Defoe was an English writer, journalist, merchant and spy. He's famous for Robinson Crusoe, published in 1719, and for Moll Flanders, Colonel Jack and Roxana. He's seen as one of the earliest champions of the English novel, and he helped popularise the form in Britain. The monument commemorates him here.
